er_grounding.definition: A deliberate act of bringing the body back to a calm state before you act on a strong feeling.
er_grounding.example: Grounding gave her the pause she needed before she answered him.

expiry_date.definition: The last date on which the maker guarantees the medicine keeps its strength and its safety.
expiry_date.example: The expiry date is on the strip, so I checked the one on the box too.

spec_generalist.definition: A person who works across several fields and can explain one of them to another.
spec_generalist.example: The generalist on the team translated the tax rule into plain words.
